senses.gloss: f. (מָשַׁח I) anointing, installation by anointing; use of the stem מָשַׁח.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 5b:97">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. (<cite ref="B01036"><he>בעי</he></cite>) <he>טעון מ׳</he> requires anointment (in order to be recognized).

<cite ref="Keritot 5b:97">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ עדיפא</he> anointing (by drawing a figure, v. <cite ref="M02846"><he>מָשַׁח</he> I</cite>) is preferable to pouring oil (<cite ref="J00536"><he>יְצִיקָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:15">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מְשִׁיחַת אהרן כיצד</he> how was Aaron’s installation done? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:15">Ib.</cite> <he>במְשִׁיחָתָן של אלו וכ׳</he> with the anointment of these vessels were all the vessels of subsequent days consecrated.
Sifré Num. 117 אין מ׳ אלא גדולה the stem משח refers to official emoluments, as we read (Lev. VII, 35) &c.; ib. אין מ׳ אלא שמן המשחה mashaḥ means installation with oil; a. fr.
